/-!
# Access kernel: state and derived notions

Abstract authority machine of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, Parts IV–VII:
frames (§39), places, leaves and footprints (§40), initialization states (§41), authorities
(§42), dynamic pinning obligations (§74, §75), the state `S3` (§38), the external contract `K`
(§48, §80), and the derived notions that the operations of §60–§75 read: usability (§40),
effective modes, exercisability and the grounding of a right (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3),
effective anchors and anchor order (§44), outcomes (§58).

Identities of places and authorities are list indices; index order represents acyclicity of
parent and origin links (§49, last paragraph). Reading decisions are recorded in the reference
pass readings, never in this file.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Frames (§39) -/

/-- Frame stack `F` (§39): frame identities, current frame first; the parent of a frame is the
next element. -/
abbrev Frames := List Nat

/-- `ancestor(f₁, f₂)` (§39): `f₁` is `f₂` or one of its ancestors in the stack. -/
def ancestor (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop := f₁ ∈ F.dropWhile (· != f₂)

/-- Decidability of `ancestor` (§39). -/
instance (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (ancestor F f₁ f₂) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∈ _))

/-! ## Parent chains (§40, §42) -/

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first, within fuel `k` (§40 structural
parents, §42 origins). Only links to a smaller index are followed (§49, last paragraph). -/
def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | k + 1, i =>
    match org i with
    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
    | none => []

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (§40, §42); fuel `i` suffices since the chain
decreases. -/
def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i

/-! ## Places, leaves, footprints (§40) -/

/-- Holder of an authority (§42) or owner of a place (§40): a frame or a place. -/
inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (§40): optional structural parent, owner, abstract `kind`. Its identity is its
index in `P`; its death marker is `S3.dead`. -/
structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Structural parent of place `i` (§40). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf(p, q)` (§40): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` or one of its structural
ancestors. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

/-- Decidability of `partOf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Leaf (§40): a place with no structural child. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

/-- Decidability of `isLeaf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint(q)` (§40): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (§63.3). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

/-- Decidability of `overlap` (§63.3). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- `OwnedIn P src q` (§40, §33): the ownership chain of `q` reaches a place owned by `src` or by
one of its parts, that is, `q` is storage owned, directly or transitively, by the value at
`src`. -/
inductive OwnedIn (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : Nat → Prop where
  | direct {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → partOf P o src →
      OwnedIn P src q
  | step {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → OwnedIn P src o →
      OwnedIn P src q

/-! ## State (§38, §41, §42) -/

/-- Initialization state of a leaf (§41). -/
inductive InitSt where
  | uninit
  | init
  | moved
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Mode of an authority or of a request (§42, §43). -/
inductive Mode where
  | observe
  | modify
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Order of requested modes, `Observe ≤ Modify` (§43). -/
def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify

/-- Decidability of the mode order (§43). -/
instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))

/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
structure Authority where
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
structure PinOb where
  place : Nat
  leaves : List Nat
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

/-! ## Decidable helpers -/

/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
components of `S3` (§38). -/
def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | some y => P y
  | none => d

/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
  match o with
  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)

/-- An index with a value is in range (§38: identities are list indices). -/
theorem lt_of_getElem? {α : Type} {l : List α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : l[i]? = some x) :
    i < l.length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 h).1

/-! ## Least fixed points on a bounded universe

`Usable` (§40), `FrameOf` (§40), `OwnedIn` (§40) and `ExercisableAt` (§43) are inductive
predicates, each the least fixed point of a monotone rule over identities below a bound `n`; the
Kleene iteration is stable after `n + 1` steps, which makes them decidable. -/

/-- `k`-th Kleene iterate of a rule `R` on Boolean predicates over `Nat` (decision procedure for
§40 and §43). -/
def kiter (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => false
  | k + 1, a => R (kiter R k) a

/-- A monotone rule whose conclusions lie below `n` and which reads its premise only below `n`
(decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
structure KRule (n : Nat) (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) : Prop where
  mono : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, p a = true → q a = true) → ∀ a, R p a = true → R q a = true
  bound : ∀ p a, R p a = true → a < n
  loc : ∀ p q : Nat → Bool, (∀ a, a < n → p a = q a) → ∀ a, R p a = R q a

/-- The iteration of a monotone rule is increasing (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem kiter_mono {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → kiter R (k + 1) a = true
  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
  | k + 1, a, hk => h.mono _ _ (kiter_mono h k) a hk

/-- Conclusions of the iteration lie below the bound (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem kiter_bound {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k a, kiter R k a = true → a < n
  | 0, _, hk => by simp [kiter] at hk
  | _ + 1, a, hk => h.bound _ a hk

/-- `countP` is monotone in the predicate (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem countP_le_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true) :
    l.countP p ≤ l.countP q := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.countP_cons]
    have := ih fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega

/-- `countP` grows strictly when one more element satisfies the predicate (decision procedure
for §40 and §43). -/
theorem countP_lt_of {l : List Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool} (hpq : ∀ a ∈ l, p a = true → q a = true)
    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ l) (hqx : q x = true) (hpx : p x = false) : l.countP p < l.countP q := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.countP_cons]
    have hle := countP_le_of (l := l) fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · simp [hqx, hpx]; omega
    · have := ih (fun b hb => hpq b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)) hx
      cases hp : p a <;> cases hq : q a <;> simp_all <;> omega

/-- A failed `all` has a witness (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem all_false_exists {α : Type} {p : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, l.all p = false →
    ∃ a ∈ l, p a = false
  | [], h => by simp at h
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_false_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self .., h⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := all_false_exists h; exact ⟨b, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb, hb'⟩

/-- Stability of the iteration at step `k`, below `n` (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
def kstab (R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool) (n k : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range n).all fun a => kiter R (k + 1) a == kiter R k a

/-- A stable iteration stays stable one step later (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem kstab_succ {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : kstab R n (k + 1) = true := by
  simp only [kstab, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, beq_iff_eq] at hs ⊢
  intro a ha
  show R (kiter R (k + 1)) a = R (kiter R k) a
  exact h.loc _ _ (fun b hb => hs b hb) a

/-- A stable iteration stays stable (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem kstab_le {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) {k : Nat}
    (hs : kstab R n k = true) : ∀ j, k ≤ j → kstab R n j = true
  | j, hj => by
    induction j with
    | zero => obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
              exact hs
    | succ j ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (j + 1) with hlt | hge
      · exact kstab_succ h (ih (by omega))
      · obtain rfl : k = j + 1 := by omega
        exact hs

/-- Before stabilizing, each step adds a conclusion (decision procedure for §40 and §43). -/
theorem kstab_exists {n : Nat} {R : (Nat → Bool) → Nat → Bool} (h : KRule n R) :
    ∀ k, (∃ j, j < k ∧ kstab R n j = true) ∨ k ≤ (List.range n).countP (kiter R k)
  | 0 => .inr (Nat.zero_le _)
  | k + 1 => by
    rcases kstab_exists h k with hj | hc
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hs⟩ := hj; exact .inl ⟨j, by omega, hs⟩
    · cases hs : kstab R n k
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hne⟩ := all_false_exists hs
        simp only [List.mem_range, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at ha hne
        have hk : kiter R k a = false := by
          cases e : kiter R k a
          · rfl
          · exact absurd (kiter_mono h k a e) (by rw [e] at hne; simpa using hne)
        have hk1 : kiter R (k + 1) a = true := by
          cases e : kiter R (k + 1) a
          · rw [e, hk] at hne; exact absurd rfl hne
          · rfl
        have := countP_lt_of (l := List.range n) (fun b _ hb => kiter_mono h k b hb)
          (List.mem_range.2 ha) hk1 hk

instance (P : List Place) (src q : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedIn P src q) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ ownedIn_iff.symm

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (§43). -/
def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
    match s.A[j]? with
    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
    | none => none

/-- Cases 2–4 of §43 for an active authority of own mode `m` covering the leaf, whose covering
active descendants have modes `ds`. -/
def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe

/-- `effective(s, a, l)` (§43, cases 1–4), computed per leaf. -/
def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
  | none => none

/-- Compatible effective modes for independent ordinary accesses: only `Observe`/`Observe`
(§50). -/
def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
§43). -/
theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
    l.any f = l.any g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
      · simpa using h.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exR at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exR; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]

/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance

/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
are accounted for transitively). -/
def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,
§67.3, §68.3). -/
def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
usable place `q`. -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
§44). -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/

/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
carries none. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject
  | fail

/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops

/-!
# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability

Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
authority is valid, that is, active. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
      (y.active = true → x.active = true)

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/

/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
whole place holding the next. -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
static (§49.2). -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
dynamic pinning obligation. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pins := [] }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.SharedMutable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.SharedMutable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Pinned` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Pinned := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.ExternalDone` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.ExternalDone := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Deallocable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Deallocable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.FreeCompat` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (K0.FreeCompat p a) := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)

/-- Three static leaves owned by frame 0 (§47): place 0 `Init`, places 1 and 2 `Uninit`. -/
def st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- `S3.init st` (§47). -/
def s0 : S3 := S3.init st
/-- After `derive(0, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 3 held by frame 0. -/
def s1 : S3 := deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify
/-- After `alloc(provider 0, owner 1, one leaf)` (§71): place 3 owned by place 1, root 3. -/
def s2 : S3 := allocEff s0 1 [(none, 0)]
/-- After `derive(1, [1], Modify)` then `store(3, 0)` (§60, §65): authority 3 on leaf 1 stored in
place 0. -/
def s3 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff s0 1 [1] .modify) 3 0
/-- After `pin(0)` (§74): obligation 0 pins leaf 0. -/
def s4 : S3 := pinEff s0 0

example : StaticsOK st := by decide
example : DerivePre s0 0 [0] .modify := by decide
example : SplitPre K0 s0 0 [[0]] := by decide
example : ReleasePre s1 3 := by decide
example : TransferPre K0 s0 0 1 := by decide
example : ¬ TransferPre K0 s0 1 0 := by decide
example : DependPre s1 2 3 := by decide
example : EnterPre s1 [3] [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
example : StorePre s1 3 1 := by decide
example : ¬ ExitPre K0 s0 := by decide
example : Read3Pre s0 0 [0] := by decide
example : Write3Pre s0 1 [1] := by decide
example : WriteSharedPre K0 s0 0 [0] := by decide
example : EndUsePre K0 s0 0 := by decide
example : FreePre K0 s2 3 0 := by decide
example : AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
example : ¬ AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (none, 0)] := by decide
example : PinPre s0 0 := by decide
example : UnpinPre K0 s4 0 := by decide
example : ¬ UnpinPre K0 s0 0 := by decide
example : ¬ EndUsePre K0 s4 0 := by decide

/-- §75: `unpin` ends only the designated obligation; with two obligations on leaf 0, ending
obligation 0 leaves the leaf pinned by obligation 1. -/
example : (unpinEff (pinEff s4 0) 0).pin 0 = true ∧ (unpinEff s4 0).pin 0 = false := by decide

/-- §63.8 decides alone: in `s3`, the transfer of place 0 to place 1 satisfies §63.1–§63.7 and
§63.9 and is rejected by local self-blocking prevention. -/
example : (s3.Usable 0 ∧ s3.Usable 1 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 1 ∧
    SameShape s3.P 0 1 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, s3.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 1, s3.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s3.P 0 1 ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s3.A.length, Grounds s3 .modify 0 g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s3.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s3 0 j → RightChain s3 g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, ¬ K0.Pinned l ∧ s3.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s3 0, s3.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s3 0 1) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s3.A.length, AnchorMoves s3 0 x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s3.P.length, (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s3 0 1).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s3 0 1) x ((transferEff s3 0 1).pframe q)) True) ∧
    (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable 1) ∧
    ¬ NoLocalSelfLock s3 0 1 ∧ ¬ TransferPre K0 s3 0 1 := by decide

end Examples

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source`, its effective anchor included, is
  active. -/
  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ (∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
transitively. -/
def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance

/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance

/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : s.Usable src
  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (§64) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (§64, `ok` effect): `anchor` is added to `D(result)`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (§64). The "real dependency" part of §64.2 is not represented;
§64.4 holds by construction (`depsOf`). -/
structure DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable q
  /-- §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify q
  /-- §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
  anchorActive : s.Active x
  /-- §64.3: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an ancestor. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` (§64). -/
instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable q ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧ s.Active x ∧ EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `depend` as a relation (§64). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## O8 `store` (§65) -/

/-- Effect of `store(authority, target)` (§65, `ok` effect): `target` becomes the holder, the
authority joins `D(target)`, and only leaf `target` becomes `Init`. -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))

/-!
# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant

Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`:

* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
* preservation of `KInv` (§57) by every step, `transfer` (§63) included, from states satisfying
  `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`; preservation of the auxiliaries `KAux` and
  `HeldAnchored` by every step; preservation of `I5` (§57) by every step from a `WF3` state;
* the initial state satisfies the invariant and the auxiliaries under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its
  `Init` leaves are the declared ones;
* the main invariant on reachable states (§57, `reachable_kinv`) and `I5` on reachable states
  (`reachable_i5`); the ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9
  (`reachable_cycle_rejected`);
* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
  fails.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
inductive KernelOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
  | release (a : Nat)

/-- Finite runs of kernel steps from `s` (§57): the reflexive-transitive closure of `KStep`. -/
inductive KStar (k : K) (s : S3) : S3 → Prop where
  /-- The empty run (§57). -/
  | refl : KStar k s s
  /-- A run followed by one kernel step (§57). -/
  | tail {t u : S3} : KStar k s t → KStep k t u → KStar k s u

/-- The reachable states of §57 are the states reached from `S3.init statics` by a finite run of
kernel steps. -/
theorem reachable_iff {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} :
  constructor
  · intro h
  · intro h

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) and the base frame (§39) -/

/-- Only `alloc` may produce `fail` among O1–O16 (§58). -/
theorem op_fail_only_alloc {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s : S3} (h : op.Step k s .fail) :
  cases op with
  | alloc pr ow ls => exact ⟨pr, ow, ls, rfl⟩
  | _ => exact (Alloc.guarded_ne_fail h).elim

/-- No kernel step changes the bottom of the frame stack (§39: the base frame never exits). -/
theorem kstep_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  cases h with
  | derive h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | split h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | release h =>
  | transfer h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | depend h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | enter h => exact enter_keeps_base h
  | exit h => exact (exit_keeps_base h).2
  | read h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | write h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | writeShared h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | pin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | unpin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | endUse h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | free h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | alloc h => cases h with | ok => rfl
  | store h =>

/-- On every reachable state, the bottom of the stack is the base frame 0 (§39, §47). -/
theorem reachable_base {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
  induction h with
  | init => rfl
  | step _ h ih => rw [kstep_base h]; exact ih

/-- The base frame 0 is never removed from the stack of a reachable state (§39). -/
theorem reachable_base_mem {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
  List.mem_of_getLast? (reachable_base h)

/-! ## Preservation by every step (§57, §58) -/

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv`
and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57, used by `transfer`, §63) to its `ok`
outcome, under `DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves hinv hheld h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv h
  | read => exact read_preserves hinv h
  | write => exact write_preserves hinv h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv h
  | free => exact free_preserves hinv h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv h
  | store => exact store_preserves hinv h

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40,
§49.7; not a clause of §57) from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` to its `ok`
outcome. -/
theorem op_preserves_kAux {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | split => exact split_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | release => exact release_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_kAux haux h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves_kAux haux h
  | read => exact read_preserves_kAux haux h
  | write => exact write_preserves_kAux haux h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_kAux haux h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves_kAux haux h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_kAux haux h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_kAux haux h
  | free => exact free_preserves_kAux haux h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
  | store => exact store_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h

/-- Every operation preserves `I5` (§57: every leaf pinned statically or by an active obligation
of §74 belongs to a usable place) from a `WF3` state (§49) to its `ok` outcome. `WF3` is used by
`transfer` (§63.9), `endUse` (§69) and `free` (§70). -/
theorem op_preserves_i5 {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s)
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | split => exact split_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | release => exact release_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | read => exact read_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | write => exact write_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | free => exact free_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_i5 h5 h
  | store => exact store_preserves_i5 h5 h

/-- Every kernel step preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv` and the auxiliary
`HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57), under `DDSound` (§80). -/
theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves hdd hinv hheld hop

/-- Every kernel step preserves `I5` (§57, §74) from a `WF3` state (§49). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_i5 {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s) (h : KStep k s s') :
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_i5 hw h5 hop

/-- Every kernel step preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7) from a state satisfying `KInv`
(§57) and `KAux`. -/
theorem kstep_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_kAux hinv haux hop

/-! ## `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every step (§44, §65, §63) -/

/-- An active derived authority of the resulting state held by place `q` is an anchor of `q`
(§44), or it was already such an authority before the step and the step keeps the anchors of `q`
when `q` was usable (§52). Under `WF3` (§49.8) this gives `HeldAnchored` after the step. -/
private theorem heldAnchored_of_step {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
  intro x y q hy ya ho hhq _
  rcases hstep x y q hy ya ho hhq with h | ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, ho₀, hh₀, himp⟩
  · exact h
  · have hu : s.Usable q := by have := hw.holders x y₀ hy₀ ya₀; rw [hh₀] at this; exact this

/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by
`derive`, `split`, `enterFrame`, `alloc`). -/
private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
  by_cases hx : x < l.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)

/-- Every operation preserves the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57) from a `WF3`
state (§44; §60–§75 `ok` effects): new
authorities are held by frames or have no origin; `store` anchors what it stores (§65); a
`transfer` moves an authority with the anchors of its holder (§63); `exitFrame` maps a surviving
anchor to itself (§73); the other steps only release authorities or keep the anchors of the
places whose authorities stay active. -/
theorem op_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s)
  cases op with
  | derive src region m =>
    (h' : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j']? = some i) : j = j' :=
  Frames.getElem?_inj_of_lt ((Frames.range_pairwise_lt _).filter _) h h'

/-- The initial state satisfies `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and
`HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) for a well-formed statics declaration (`StaticsOK`, §47:
acyclic ownership of statics; §49, ordering of identifiers). -/
theorem init_kinv {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KInv (S3.init statics) ∧ KAux (S3.init statics) ∧ HeldAnchored (S3.init statics) := by
  have hus : ∀ i, i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i :=
    fun i hi => init_usable hst (i + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hi
  have hof : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .frame f → f < (S3.init statics).nF := by
  have hop : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .place o → o < (S3.init statics).P.length := by
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := {
    frames := ⟨by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init]⟩
    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
    owners := ⟨hof, hop, fun _ hq => hq.frameOf⟩
    footprints := fun a x ha l hl => by
    origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
    rootChain := fun a y l ha hl _ => by
        fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    rootHeld := fun r hr _ => by
          Option.isNone_none, and_self]
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) r, true⟩, _, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, initP_get hrl,
        rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    holders := fun a y ha _ => by
      | none => exact List.mem_singleton_self _
      | some o => exact hus o (Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hil ho) hil) }
  have hconv : RootHeldConv (S3.init statics) := fun x z l r hx _ hl hrp hlr => by
  have hi1 : I1 (S3.init statics) := fun a b x y p hab ha hb _ _ xp yp _ _ => by
      (mem_footprint.1 yp).2.2) hii
  have hnd : NoDangling (S3.init statics) := fun _ _ _ _ q hq l hl _ =>
    hq (hus q (init_lt_of_mem_footprint hl))
  have haoh : AnchorOrderHeld (S3.init statics) := fun q hq x y hy _ hhq => by
  refine ⟨kInv_of hw ⟨⟨hi1, ?_, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, hnd⟩ haoh,
    hconv, fun x y q hy _ ho _ _ => ?_⟩
  · intro b y a hb ho
  · cases hx
  · cases hx
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy; exact absurd rfl ho

/-- The `Init` leaves of the initial state are exactly the statics declared `Init` (§47, §59). -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) hold on every
state reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound` (§80), for well-formed statics
(`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
theorem reachable_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
      kstep_preserves_heldAnchored ih.1.1 ih.2.2 h⟩

/-- The main invariant of §57: on states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`
(§80), `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan` holds, for well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`,
§47). -/
theorem reachable_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : KInv s :=
  (reachable_inv hdd hst h).1

/-- `I5` (§57) on reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every leaf
pinned statically (`K.Pinned`) or by an active obligation (§74) belongs to a usable place in every
reachable state. No hypothesis on `K.Pinned`: initially every static is usable (§47) and a leaf
lies in its own footprint (§40). -/
theorem reachable_i5 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : I5 k s := by
  induction h with
  | init =>
      mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlt, hleaf, hlt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  | step hr h ih => exact kstep_preserves_i5 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 ih h

open TransferWitness in
/-- The ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9: `cyc2` is reachable under a contract
with `DDSound` (§80), `transfer(0, 3)` from it is rejected because its destination would not be
usable, and the resulting state of that transfer, which violates `KInv` (§49.8, §54), is not
reachable (§57). -/
theorem reachable_cycle_rejected : Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 ∧
    TransferStep Examples.K0 0 3 cyc2 .reject ∧ ¬ Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc3 := by
  obtain ⟨hdd, hr, -, -, -, -, hrej, hn⟩ := transfer_cycle_rejected
  exact ⟨hr, hrej, fun h => hn (reachable_kinv hdd (by decide) h)⟩

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .writeShared _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .store _ p => l = p
  | .transfer src dst => l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
      ∃ l' ∈ footprint s.P src, corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init
  | _ => False

/-- In every `ok` step, a leaf that becomes `Init` is written by the step (§59): a permitted write
(`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already
`Init`. -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hl : s.I l ≠ .init) (hl' : s'.I l = .init) : op.Writes s l := by
  cases op with
  | derive => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | release a =>
  | transfer src dst =>
        else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l := rfl
        mem_footprint.2 ⟨List.mem_range.1 hr, kids_nil_iff.1 hkr, hrs⟩
  | depend => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | enter ps ls =>
  | exit => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | write a ls =>
  | writeShared a ls =>
  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | endUse p =>
  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | alloc pr ow ls =>
    | ok _ _ =>
  | store a p =>

/-- Every `Init` leaf of a state reached by a run from `S3.init statics` was declared `Init`
(§47) or was made `Init` by a write step of that run (§59): a step `t → t'` of the run, through
an operation writing the leaf, after which the run continues from `t'` to the final state. -/
theorem init_history {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : KStar k (S3.init statics) s) (hl : s.I l = .init) :
    (∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true) ∨
      ∃ (t t' : S3) (op : KernelOp), KStar k (S3.init statics) t ∧ op.Step k t (.ok t') ∧
        t.I l ≠ .init ∧ t'.I l = .init ∧ op.Writes t l ∧ KStar k t' s := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .inl ((init_statics statics l).1 hl)
  | tail ht hst ih =>
    rename_i t u

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
