# Reading policy for the reference kernel (fixed by the orchestrator; every item is reported for arbitration)

General
- The frozen spec specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md is the only semantic source. Cite clauses as §N or §N.k (item k).
- Formalize each clause as written. Never add a clause the text does not state (no "robustness"); never drop one.
- When a clause has no checkable content in the state (undefined term), do not invent content: omit it from the definition and record it in readings.md (clause, quote, why it cannot be formalized).
- When a clause has two readings, use the one listed below; if the case is not listed, use the draft's reading if the draft matches one of the readings, and record it in readings.md with both readings and an example of a program whose verdict changes.
- A representation choice that changes no accepted program is free (record it briefly).

State (§38): S3 = (F, nF, P, I, A, D, dead, pin). No arena registry, no callParams, no freed. Library state lives elsewhere.
Outcomes (§58): one type Outcome3 σ := ok σ | reject | fail; every O1–O16 relation except alloc never yields fail.
O1 derive (§60): takes a region (List Nat, read extensionally), not a place. Preconditions: active source; ExercisableAt source mode; every leaf of region exists, is a leaf, belongs to afp source; mode ≤ effective mode of source on each leaf; §60.3 as a decidable clause (no unrelated active authority becomes incompatible); §60.4 current frame live. §60.1c "origin chain and anchors valid" and §60.4b "footprint and anchoring restrictions": no checkable content -> omitted, recorded.
O2 split (§61): draft clauses (incl. no exclusive right already distributed). §61.4 is NOT a precondition (the §61 note says an accepted split may violate I1 without DDSound) -> recorded.
O3 release (§62): draft clauses; §62.5 (abstraction contracts) omitted, recorded.
O4 transfer (§63): draft clauses MINUS the draft's extra clause "(transferEff s src dst).Usable dst" (not in §63); PLUS §63.8 (local self-blocking prevention, as LockOptions.Opt2Transfer on formal/derivability_0.1); effect: dependencies follow the corresponding places corr(r) (not all to the destination root); §63.6 over moved usable places and AnchorOrder in the resulting state; §63.7 AnchorOrderHeld for the moved held authorities in the resulting state; §63.4 = draft ActiveDerivedOutside reading (recorded); §63.2 child order = place index order (recorded).
O5 depend (§64): draft clauses; §64.2b "real dependency" omitted, recorded.
O8 store (§65): draft clauses (they match).
O9/O10/O11 (§66–§68): add "every leaf belongs to a usable place" (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1); O10 keeps §67.2 explicitly.
O12 endUse (§69): death markers transitive over owned storage; drop the draft's extra disjunct that blocks descendants of authorities the step releases (not in §69.2) -> record the consequence.
O13 free (§70): death markers transitive; no extra "Usable p" and no clearing of D beyond what §70 prescribes; §70.4 scope = the released unit (place and storage that dies with it).
O14 alloc (§71): shape nonempty with exactly ONE root (one new storage root), parts' parents inside the shape, no owner component; provider clause as written in §71.2 (Modify OR writeShared over SharedMutable metadata) -> conflict with §36 recorded; outcomes reject / fail (not Satisfiable) / ok.
O6 enterFrame (§72): locals owned directly by the new frame (no local owned by another local); §72.3 ParamOriginHidden; §72.4 AnchorOrderHeld in the resulting state.
O7 exitFrame (§73): draft (first surviving active origin, held by a frame or a usable place).
O15/O16 pin/unpin (§74, §75): per-leaf dynamic pin flags (draft); unpin requires the place usable and K.ExternalDone(place) on the place; StaticPinnedBottom is a condition on (K, statics), not on states.
HasRight / ExercisableAt (§43): one authority exercisable at m with sufficient effective mode on every leaf (∃ a, ∀ l) as the draft -> recorded.
WF3 (§49): a structure with eight named fields, one per item:
 1 frames: F nonempty, no duplicates, every frame < nF;
 2 places: parent links valid and acyclic (representation: parent index < child index), parts share the owner and death marker of their parent;
 3 owners: owner frames < nF, owner places exist; "well-founded ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place" read as stated for usable places (Usable is inductive) -> recorded with the global-acyclicity alternative;
 4 footprints: every footprint member is an existing leaf;
 5 authorities: origins exist and precede (origin index < id: representation of acyclic chains ending at a root);
 6 RootChain (draft);
 7 RootHeld as §49.7 states it: every usable root place has an active root authority, Modify, no origin, held by its owner, whose footprint is the place's footprint (draft RootLive + mode);
 8 holder validity (draft poss).
 The draft's converse RootHeld (every origin-less authority covering a leaf of root r is held by r's owner) is NOT a WF3 clause: keep it as a separate auxiliary predicate.
I2 (§51): mode conservation unconditional (not under ∀ p ∈ footprint).
Initial state (§47): base frame 0; statics may be owned by statics; root authority held by the owner. Well-formedness of the statics declaration (acyclic ownership, parents before children) is not stated by §47: keep the draft ShapeOK-style hypothesis as a hypothesis of the init theorems and record it as a spec gap.
Reachable: closure of S3.init statics under the kernel steps O1–O16 only.

/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s

/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
  over the written leaves. -/
  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }

/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
  /-- §68.2: `access` is exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §68.2: `access` has a present effective mode on every leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §68.3: dependencies are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `writeShared` (§68). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
    Decidable (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `writeShared` as a relation (§68). -/
def WriteSharedStep (k : K) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Arenas: the reference library abstraction (Part XIV)

Arenas of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, Part XIV (§76–§78), with §36, §46, §55,
§56, §58, §79, §86 and §88. An arena is a library abstraction (Part XIV): its entries live in a
library state separate from the kernel state `S₃` (§38, §46). `newArena` (O17) only registers an
entry; `issue` (O18) and `reset` (O19) are defined twice:

* as their contracts, clause by clause (§77, §78): `IssueC`, `ResetC`;
* as derived operations over the kernel steps (Part XIV): `issue` is its static checks, the
  availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` on the region and `store` of the block into the
  destination (`IssueD`); `reset` is `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the whole storage,
  then `release`, then the explicit check of §78.3 (`ResetD`), which never rejects after an
  accepted `derive` on states satisfying I3 (`resetNoDeps_of_derive`).

On library-reachable states, `issue_as_kernel` and `reset_as_kernel` show that both definitions
have the same outcomes and the same arrival states, `reset_iff_derive_release` that `reset` is
accepted or rejected exactly when `derive` then `release` is (Q7), and `lReach_inv` that every
live entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). Library reachability (`LReach`, `LReachNG`) uses the derived
operations, so its kernel states are kernel-reachable (`newArena_as_library`) and satisfy the
kernel invariant of §57 (`Access.reachable_kinv`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library state (§46) -/

/-- Arena entry (§46): administered storage, `internal` authority, available leaves and issued
regions with their block authorities. The sets of §46 are lists read by membership. -/
structure ArenaEntry where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§46, §38): the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena registry. -/
structure LState where
  kern : S3
  arenas : List ArenaEntry

/-- Initial library state (§47): the initial kernel state and an empty arena registry. -/
def LState.init (statics : Statics) : LState := ⟨S3.init statics, []⟩

/-- Live arena (§46): `internal` is active. -/
def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal

/-- Decidability of `Live` (§46). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (Live s E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (s.Active _))

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-! ## `ArenaInv` (§55) -/

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55), required for live arenas. "Still-issued" is read as "with an active block
authority". The clause "anchor and ownership restrictions are respected" has no referent and is
not represented; "complying with exclusivity and validity rules" is left to the kernel
invariants (§57). -/
structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
  active : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2

/-- Decidability of `ArenaInv` (§55): the footprint equality is the two inclusions. -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ArenaInv s E) :=
  @decidable_of_iff (ArenaInv s E) ((s.Usable E.storage ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp E.internal, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage, l ∈ s.afp E.internal) ∧ s.Active E.internal ∧
    OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False) ∧
    ((∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage)) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
      ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2))
    ⟨fun ⟨⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, ⟨f, g⟩, h, i, j⟩ => ⟨a, fun l => ⟨b l, c l⟩, d, e, f, g, h, i, j⟩,
     fun h => ⟨⟨h.storageUsable, fun l => (h.fpEq l).1, fun l => (h.fpEq l).2, h.active,
      h.shape⟩, ⟨h.availableIn, h.issuedIn⟩, h.disjoint, h.notAvailable, h.derived⟩⟩
    (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance inferInstance))

/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify

/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E

/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)

/-! ## A decision procedure for the kernel invariant on concrete states (§49–§54, §57)
  rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set hF with hF | rfl
  · exact hold F hF
  · obtain ⟨hlt, hinv'⟩ := hold E hEm
    refine ⟨hlt, fun hl => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hai, -⟩ := hinv' hl
    exact ⟨⟨hai.storageUsable, hai.fpEq, hai.active, hai.shape, fun l hl => hl,
      fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he),
      fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩, fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩

/-- A kernel step of non-administrative code preserves the library invariant (§55), when the
state before satisfies `WF3` and the state after `NoDangling` (§57): the storage of a live arena
stays usable since `internal` covers it. -/
theorem lInv_kernel {k : K} {L : LState} {s' : S3} (hk : KStep k L.kern s') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling s') (hi : LInv L) : LInv ⟨s', L.arenas⟩ := by
  have hA := kstep_akeep hk
  intro E hE
  obtain ⟨hlt, hinv⟩ := hi E hE
  refine ⟨hA.lt hlt, fun hlive => ?_⟩
  have hEI := hinv (hA.active_back hlive hlt)
  have hfp := kstep_fp hk hEI.1.storageUsable.lt
  refine entryInv_transport hEI hA hfp ?_ hlive
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (L.kern.P.length - E.storage + 1) E.storage (by omega)
    hEI.1.storageUsable.lt
  obtain ⟨yi, hyi, -⟩ := hEI.1.active
  obtain ⟨y', hy', -, hf', -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  obtain ⟨y'', hy'', ya''⟩ := hlive
  rw [hy'] at hy''; cases hy''
  have hli : l ∈ yi.footprint := by
    have := (hEI.1.fpEq l).2 hl; simpa [S3.afp, hyi] using this
  exact usable_of_covered hnd hy' ya'' (hf' ▸ hli) ((hfp l).2 hl)

/-- Every library step, with or without the guard of §56, preserves the library invariant (§55),
when the kernel state before satisfies `WF3` and the one after `NoDangling` (§57). -/
theorem lInv_stepNG {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStepNG k L L') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L'.kern) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact lInv_kernel hk hw hnd hi
  | newArena hb => exact lInv_newArena hb hi
  | issue hs => exact lInv_issue hs hi
  | reset hs => exact lInv_reset hs hi

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) on library runs, with or without the guard of §56: in every library state
reachable under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every registered `internal` exists and
every live entry satisfies `EntryInv`. The kernel states of such runs are kernel-reachable
(`LReachNG.reachable`), so they satisfy `WF3` and `NoDangling` (`Access.reachable_kinv`, §57),
which `lInv_stepNG` asks of them. -/
theorem lReachNG_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReachNG k statics L) : LInv L := by
  induction h with
  | init => intro E hE; cases hE
  | step hL hs ih =>
    exact lInv_stepNG hs (reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.reachable).1
      (reachable_kinv hdd hst (hL.step hs).reachable).2.1.2.2 ih

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) on library-reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
every live entry of a library-reachable state satisfies `ArenaInv` (`lReachNG_inv`). -/
theorem lReach_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReach k statics L) : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L.kern E → ArenaInv L.kern E :=
  fun E hE hl => ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst h.ng E hE).2 hl).1

/-- `issue_as_kernel` (Part XIV, §77, §58): on every library-reachable state, under `DDSound`
(§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), the contract of `issue` and the derived operation (`split` then
`store`) have the same outcomes, `ok`, `fail` and `reject`, with the same arrival state, kernel
part included (literal equality, `issueKEff_eq`). The kernel invariant
(`Access.reachable_kinv`) and `ArenaInv` of the entry (`lReach_inv`) hold there. -/
theorem issue_as_kernel {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (o : Outcome3 LState) : IssueC i region dst L o ↔ IssueD k i region dst L o :=
  issue_as_kernel_of_inv k (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr.ng.reachable)

/-! ## Frames (§39) -/

/-- Neither step changes the bottom of the stack (§39: the base frame never exits): `exitFrame`
keeps a nonempty stack with the same last frame. -/
theorem exit_keeps_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    s'.F ≠ [] ∧ s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨hpre.hasCaller, ?_⟩
  show s.F.tail.getLast? = s.F.getLast?
  cases hF : s.F with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons f F₀ => exact (getLast?_cons_ne (by simpa [hF] using hpre.hasCaller)).symm

/-- Neither step changes the bottom of the stack (§39: the base frame never exits):
`enterFrame` pushes the new frame on top. -/
theorem enter_keeps_base {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact getLast?_cons_ne hpre.callerLive

/-- An exited frame leaves the stack and is the terminal owner of no usable place (§39, §73 `ok`
effect, first item). -/
theorem exitFrame_frame_gone {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    s.top ∉ s'.F ∧ ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ¬ FrameOf s' q s.top := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨f, F₀, hF⟩ : ∃ f F₀, s.F = f :: F₀ := by
  have hnd := (List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hw.frames.2.1)).1
  have htop : s.top = f := by simp [S3.top, hF]
  have hF' : (exitEff s).F = F₀ := by simp [exitEff, hF]
  rw [htop, hF']
  refine ⟨hnd, fun q hq hfq => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgF⟩ := hq.frameOf
  have e := FrameOf.det hfq hg
  rw [hF', ← e] at hgF
  exact hnd hgF

/-! ## Release at the exit (§73 `ok` effect, §39, §45) -/

/-- `exitFrame_releases_all` (§73 `ok` effect, second item; §39; §45): after an `ok` exit, an
authority held by the exited frame or by a place that is no longer usable is released, with its
holder unchanged (it is not returned to the caller); every active authority has a live holder,
other than the exited frame. -/
theorem exitFrame_releases_all {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y →
      (y.holder = .frame s.top ∨ ∃ p, y.holder = .place p ∧ ¬ s'.Usable p) →
      ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ y'.active = false ∧ y'.holder = y.holder) ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      HolderLive s' y.holder ∧ y.holder ≠ .frame s.top) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨f, F₀, hF⟩ : ∃ f F₀, s.F = f :: F₀ := by
  have hnd := (List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hw.frames.2.1)).1
  have htop : s.top = f := by simp [S3.top, hF]
  have hlive : ∀ hd, HolderLive (exitEff s) hd ↔ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) hd :=
    HolderLive.congr (s := ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3)) (s' := exitEff s) rfl rfl rfl
  have hnot : ¬ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) (.frame f) := by

  · have hns : ¬ Survives s s.F.tail j := by

/-! ## No dangling authority after the exit (§73, §54) -/

/-- `exitFrame_no_dangling` (§73, §54): from a state satisfying `WF3` (§49), `I1` (§50) and
`NoDangling` (§54), clauses of §57, after an `ok` exit no active authority covers a leaf of a
place that is not usable, in particular of a local of the exited frame or of storage dying with
it. -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h1 : I1 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, ¬ s'.Usable q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →

surviving authority stays active with its own mode, footprint and holder; it keeps no origin if
it had none; otherwise its origin becomes the first surviving active origin of its chain: no
earlier ancestor survives, and that origin is active and held, after the exit, by a frame of the
stack or by a usable place. -/
theorem exitFrame_reanchors {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) {a : Nat}
    {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (hs : Survives s s.F.tail a) :
    ∃ y', s'.A[a]? = some y' ∧ y'.active = true ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧
      y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ y'.holder = y.holder ∧
      (y.origin = none → y'.origin = none) ∧
      (y.origin ≠ none → ∃ (z : Nat) (pre post : List Nat) (yz : Authority),
        y'.origin = some z ∧ s.ancs a = pre ++ z :: post ∧
        (∀ w ∈ pre, ¬ Survives s s.F.tail w) ∧
        s'.A[z]? = some yz ∧ yz.active = true ∧ HolderLive s' yz.holder) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hlive : ∀ hd, HolderLive (exitEff s) hd ↔ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) hd :=
    HolderLive.congr (s := ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3)) (s' := exitEff s) rfl rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨ym, yf, yh⟩ := Frames.exitG_same s s.F.tail a y
  refine ⟨_, by rw [Frames.exit_A_get, hy]; rfl, Frames.exitG_surv hy hs, ym, yf, yh,
    fun ho => by simp [exitG, hs, ho], fun ho => ?_⟩
  have horg : s.org a ≠ none := by simpa [S3.org, hy] using ho
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1
    (hpre.origins a (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) hs horg)
  obtain ⟨-, pre, post, hl, hpre'⟩ := List.find?_eq_some_iff_append.1 hz
  obtain ⟨-, hzs⟩ := Frames.firstSurv_some hz
  have hzs' := hzs
  unfold Survives OptP at hzs'
  split at hzs'
  · rename_i yz hyz
      by rw [Frames.exit_A_get, hyz]; rfl, Frames.exitG_surv hyz hzs, ?_⟩
  · exact hzs'.elim

/-- Reanchoring of anchors (§73 `ok` effect, third item; §73.5): after an `ok` exit, every anchor
of a usable place is replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its origins,
which is an anchor of the place after the exit and is active. -/
theorem exitFrame_reanchors_anchors {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, ∃ z, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) = some z ∧
      (z = x ∨ z ∈ s.ancs x) ∧ z ∈ s'.D q ∧ s'.Active z := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq₁ : ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q := Frames.exit_usable_iff.1 hq
  have hne := hpre.anchors q (List.mem_range.2 (Frames.usable_of_tail hq₁).lt) hq₁ x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 hne
  obtain ⟨hzm, hzs⟩ := Frames.firstSurv_some hz
  have hmem : z ∈ (exitEff s).D q := List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, by simp [hz]⟩
  refine ⟨z, hz, List.mem_cons.1 hzm, hmem, ?_⟩
  have hzs' := hzs
  unfold Survives OptP at hzs'
  split at hzs'
  · rename_i yz hyz
  · exact hzs'.elim

/-! ## Parameters (§45, §72) -/

/-- The caller yields its parameters (§45; §72 `ok` effect): after an `ok` entry the new frame is
the current frame, it holds every parameter, the other existing authorities are unchanged, and
every new authority is the root authority (no origin) of a root local, held by the new frame, so
the caller keeps no copy of a parameter. -/
theorem enter_yields {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hw : WF3 s)
    (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) :
    s'.top = s.nF ∧ s.nF ∉ s.F ∧ s'.F = s.nF :: s.F ∧
    (∀ j < s.A.length, s'.A[j]? =
      (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s'.top } else y) ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A.length ≤ j → s'.A[j]? = some y →
      y.origin = none ∧ y.holder = .frame s'.top) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have htop : (enterEff s ps ls).top = s.nF := rfl
  refine ⟨htop, ?_, rfl, fun j hj => by rw [htop]; exact Frames.enter_lt hj,
    fun j y hj hy => ?_⟩
  · exact fun hm => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hw.frames.2.2 _ hm)
  · rcases Frames.enter_get hy with ⟨hj', -⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, rfl⟩

/-- §71.2: the provider is a usable place. -/
  providerUsable : s.Usable provider
  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner

/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
`owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)

kernel steps O1–O16 (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7), under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),

theorem pReach_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact (pstep_kernel (reachable_kinv hdd hst ih) hs).reachable ih

/-- The guarantee of §57 on the kernel side of library runs (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7, O5.g;
non-normative library contract): every kernel state of a library-reachable state satisfies

/-- The kernel part of a library step without the guard is reached by kernel steps (Part XIV,
§57: `newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive`
then `release`). -/
theorem LStepNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L L' : LState}
    (hr : Reachable k statics L.kern) (h : LStepNG k L L') : Reachable k statics L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
  | newArena _ => exact hr
  | issue hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
  | reset hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hd hrl _ => exact .step (.step hr (.derive hd)) (.release hrl)

/-- The kernel state of every library state reachable without the guard is kernel-reachable
(§57, Part XIV). -/
theorem LReachNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState}
    (h : LReachNG k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih

/-- `newArena_as_library` (Part XIV, §56, §57): registration changes no kernel component, and no
safety property of §57 depends on the guard of §56: every property of kernel-reachable states holds
for the kernel states of library runs with or without the guard. -/
theorem newArena_as_library (k : K) (statics : Statics) :
    (∀ (others : List (List Nat)) (st i : Nat) (L L' : LState),
      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → L'.kern = L.kern) ∧
    (∀ L, LReach k statics L → LReachNG k statics L) ∧
    ∀ Q : S3 → Prop, (∀ s, Reachable k statics s → Q s) →
      ∀ L, LReachNG k statics L → Q L.kern :=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ h => newArena_kernel h, fun _ h => h.ng, fun _ hQ _ h => hQ _ h.reachable⟩

/-! ## Transport of `EntryInv` (§55) -/

/-- `s'` keeps the authorities of `s` (§42, §58): each keeps its mode and footprint, becomes
active only if it was, stays held by a place if it was, and keeps an origin `o` below it that is
active in `s'`. -/
def AKeep (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ j y, s.A[j]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ y'.mode = y.mode ∧
    y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
    (y'.holder.isPlace = false → y.holder.isPlace = false) ∧
    ∀ o, y.origin = some o → o < j → s'.Active o → y'.origin = some o

theorem transfer_no_duplicate_authority {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    SameSkel s s' ∧ ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y →
      s'.A[b]? = some (if heldIn s.P src y.holder then
        { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨transfer_skel s src dst, fun b y hy => by rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; rfl⟩

/-- §63 `ok` effect, first item, and §41, §53: after an accepted transfer every source leaf is
`Moved`, and no read of a region containing one is permitted. -/
theorem transfer_invalidates_source {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s'.I l = .moved ∧ ∀ a ls, l ∈ ls → ¬ Read3Pre s' a ls := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro l hl
  have hm : (transferEff s src dst).I l = .moved := by
    simp only [transferEff, show l ∉ footprint s.P dst from fun h' => hpre.disjoint ⟨l, hl, h'⟩,
      hl, ↓reduceIte]
  exact ⟨hm, fun a ls hls => i4_always _ a ls l hls hm⟩

/-- §63 `ok` effect, fourth item: the dependencies of each part `r` of the source follow the
value to the corresponding part `corr(r)` of the destination and leave `r`; every other place
keeps its anchors; no anchor appears from elsewhere. -/
theorem transfer_deps_follow {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ r, partOf s.P r src → ∃ r', corr s.P src dst r = some r' ∧ partOf s.P r' dst ∧
      ∀ x ∈ s.D r, x ∈ s'.D r') ∧
    (∀ r, partOf s.P r src → s'.D r = []) ∧
    (∀ q, ¬ partOf s.P q src → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ∈ s'.D q) ∧
    (∀ q x, x ∈ s'.D q → (¬ partOf s.P q src ∧ x ∈ s.D q) ∨
      ∃ r, partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q ∧ x ∈ s.D r) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨fun r hr => ?_, fun r hr => by rw [transfer_D]; simp [hr],
    fun q hq x hx => by
      rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx,
    fun q x hx => ?_⟩
/-- After a transfer, a part of `dst` has the frame of `dst` (§40, §63). -/
theorem transfer_pframe_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe r' = (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact pframe_eq_of_owner hpd hpr ho

/-- A transfer creates and duplicates no authority: it changes holders only (§63, §53). -/
theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩
  rw [transfer_A_get]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A place usable after a transfer of a usable `src` was usable before (§40, §63). -/
theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src)
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

/-- Compatibility of effective modes is symmetric (§50). -/
theorem Compat.symm {m₁ m₂ : Mode} (h : Compat m₁ m₂) : Compat m₂ m₁ := ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

/-- `I4` holds in every state (§53, first sentence): a read requires `Init` on every leaf read
(§66.1). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ l hl hm h => by rw [h.init l hl] at hm; cases hm

/-! ## Consequences of `I2` (§51) -/

  ⟨fun ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩ => ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩, fun ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩ => ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩⟩

/-! ## Consequences of `I1` (§50) -/

/-- Under `I1`, two distinct authorities with present effective modes on a leaf have compatible
effective modes, `Observe`/`Observe` (§50, second paragraph). -/
theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →

/-- Abstract allocation (§9 ¶1). Its identity is its key in `State.allocs`. `bytes` is
indexed by offset from `base`; offsets outside `[0, size)` are reached by no permitted
access (`Spatial`). `freeAuth = some d` records the deallocation token `d` of a
deallocatable allocation (§9 ¶1 b8, §17 ¶4); `none` marks a non-deallocatable one. -/
structure Alloc where
  space : Nat
  base : Nat
  size : Nat
  align : Nat
  live : Bool
  bytes : Nat → AByte
  freeAuth : Option Nat

/-- Place of the minimal kernel: allocation identity, offset and length (§11 ¶1). -/
structure Place where
  alloc : Nat
  off : Nat
  len : Nat

/-- Means of access: address, provenance (an allocation identity), length and elementary
access authority (§12 ¶1, §12 ¶2). -/
structure Access where
  addr : Nat
  prov : Nat
  len : Nat
  auth : Auth

/-- Abstract state: registered allocations by identity, live or dead, and the counter `next`
representing the freshness discipline (§9 ¶7, §13 ¶1). -/
structure State where
  allocs : Nat → Option Alloc
  next : Nat

/-- Well-formedness of identities and freshness: no identity at or above the counter is
registered (§9 ¶7, §9 ¶8 b1). -/
def WF (s : State) : Prop := ∀ i, s.next ≤ i → s.allocs i = none

/-- Spatial containment of an access in an allocation (§15 ¶1; used by §15.2 and §16.2). -/
def Spatial (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size

/-- Spatial containment is decidable (§15 ¶1). -/
instance (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Decidable (Spatial a ac) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size))

/-- The `len` bytes from offset `off` are initialized (§15.3, read as: every byte of the
accessed range). -/
def Alloc.InitRange (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit

/-- Initialization of a range is decidable (§15.3). -/
instance (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Decidable (a.InitRange off len) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit))

/-- Kernel conditions of a raw typed read by `ac`: §15.1, §15.2, §15.3 and §15.5. The
conditions §15.4, §15.6 and §15.7 are the parametric obligations of `ReadOblSpec`. -/
def CanRead (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧
    a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧ Auth.read ≤ ac.auth
